# Pastemorphic

> A free, open-source browser extension that stores short pieces of text you
> paste often and puts one back on your clipboard with a click. Its notes are
> kept as ordinary browser bookmarks, so they sync between computers using the
> browser's own bookmark sync — with no account, no server and no network
> requests of any kind.

Licence: GNU GPL v3. Version 1.0.0.
Published by Lightmorphic Ltd, 82a James Carter Road, Mildenhall, IP28 7DE,
United Kingdom. Registered in England and Wales, company number 17423646:
https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/17423646
Contact: pastemorphic@lightmorphic.com
Works in Chrome, Brave, Vivaldi, Edge and other Chromium browsers, and Firefox.

## Key facts

- Cost: free. No paid tier, no trial, no upgrade.
- Storage: one bookmark per note, in a bookmark folder named Pastemorphic.
  The note's text is held inside the bookmark's web address.
- Sync: whatever the browser's own bookmark sync does. Pastemorphic takes no
  part in it and cannot see it.
- Account: none. No sign-in, no email address collected.
- Network: none. No server, no analytics, no advertising, no crash reporting.
- Permissions: bookmarks, storage, contextMenus, scripting, activeTab,
  clipboardWrite. No host permissions, so no access to the sites you visit.
- Limits: up to six tabs of seven letters each; unlimited notes; four keyboard
  shortcuts, which is the maximum a browser allows an extension to arrive with.
- Known trade-off: because notes are bookmarks, anyone who can open the browser
  can read them. Passwords and card numbers do not belong in it.
- Installation without a Google account: download the zip from GitHub releases,
  unzip, open the browser's extensions page, enable Developer mode, choose
  Load unpacked.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://pastemorphic.lightmorphic.com/): what it is and how it works.
- [Help](https://pastemorphic.lightmorphic.com/help.html): saving, copying, pasting, tabs, keyboard shortcuts, imports, backups.
- [Questions and answers](https://pastemorphic.lightmorphic.com/faq.html): sixteen plain answers.
- [Privacy](https://pastemorphic.lightmorphic.com/privacy.html): what is stored, where, and why each permission is asked for.
- [Source code](https://github.com/lightmorphic/pastemorphic): the whole extension, nine plain files with no build step.
